title: Operator-tailored VPC onboarding playbook and upgrade UX
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, operator-focused onboarding playbook for Private/VPC installs that pairs a linear install map with inline upgrade/rollback UI states and operator diagnostics. Emphasize terminal-first and GUI hybrid flows, clear error surface, and progressive disclosure for advanced network settings.
context: Existing assets focus on first-time user walkthroughs and visual checklists. This work targets platform operators and SREs who run appliance or VPC installs in regulated environments and need concise runbooks, rollback actions, and upgrade conflict resolution screens.
goals: Provide a single-page install map that adapts to installer mode (CLI, appliance, private console)
Create upgrade UI states for canary, pausing, rollback, and conflict resolution
Surface network diagnostics and CIDR validation inline during setup
Produce a small asset pack: SVG flow-map, step cards, inline modal screenshots, annotated terminal screenshots
deliverables: SVG interactive install map (desktop and mobile variants)
6 onboarding card designs with states (pending, running, success, error, retry)
Upgrade flow screenshots and modal copy for canary/pause/rollback
Annotated terminal and network diagnostic screenshots
Content guidelines for copy and microcopy for each state
acceptance_criteria: Install map renders legible at 1200px and 360px widths
Cards include clear primary action and secondary fallback per state
Upgrade modal shows canary percentage control and a visible rollback button when a regression is detected
Diagnostic overlay exposes CIDR conflicts, port probe failures, and KMS connectivity errors with recommended remediation links
decisions: Prefer compact linear map over multi-pane wizard after stakeholder review
Show terminal-first mode toggle in top-right of map
Default canary to 5% with adjustable slider; require manual confirmation for rollback
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: scoped deliverables with PM and SRE; confirmed diagnostics list
2026-03-05: first pass wireframes delivered; engineering noted need for CIDR validation component
2026-03-09: visual direction review; opted for muted color palette with high-contrast error badges
next_steps: Deliver final SVG exports and screenshot mocks
Coordinate with ENG for component props for diagnostics overlay
Prepare handoff doc and copy tokens for Console implementation
notes: Copy should avoid guiding operators to unsafe shortcuts; emphasise audit logs and KMS checks in upgrade flows
